root_cause: requirements.txt me package name galat likha gaya hai - 'fake_missing_package' install nahi ho pa raha
explanation: Commit message me likha hai 'fix requirement.txt fake missing package1.0' lekin test runtime pe 'fake_missing_package' module nahi mil raha. Ya to requirements.txt me package name typo hai, ya package PyPI pe exist hi nahi karta, ya phir requirements.txt update hone ke baad dependencies install nahi hui. Test file import kar rahi hai lekin package environment me available nahi hai.
suggested_fix: 1. requirements.txt me package name check karo - sahi spelling aur version confirm karo 2. Agar package real hai to 'pip install -r requirements.txt' run karo 3. Agar ye fake/test package hai to isko requirements.txt se remove karo ya test_app.py se iski dependency hatao 4. CI pipeline me ensure karo ki dependencies install step properly run ho raha hai
